flags.summary: How the dinner with Strahd in the dining hall ended (castle_ravenloft/gates_dinner): dined (he thanked his guests and left them the house for the night) or affront (the party drew on him at his table; crg_dinner_affront). Unset if there was no dinner. Endings and epilogues may read it.
A failed Insight at dinner: Strahd caught the party studying him and says so when he leaves.
Insight at dinner saw what Strahd wants from the party: not to be bored. He answers it when he leaves.
Medicine at dinner: the wine is only wine, very old. Banter remembers it.
A cleric said grace at Strahd's table (guard: once).
The fight at dinner (crg_dinner_affront) is won: Strahd left, the bats are dead. The dining hall's Narrator line and banter read it.

The hearth at the end of the hall of faces, which burns on nothing, is out (gates_hearth). Its fire stops, the secret door beside it will move, and unless it went out quietly the hall's guardians wake (crg_faces_wake).
The hearth went out quietly (holy water or Arcana), so crg_faces_wake never starts.
A failed Arcana check knotted the hearth's spell tighter: that way to put the fire out is closed.
The party opened the strongbox in the hidden room behind the hearth (container crg_hearth_hoard; the Tarokka place castle_ravenloft_hidden_hearth).
The party searched the chapel's dusty altar (container crg_chapel_altar; the Tarokka place castle_ravenloft_chapel).
The gargoyles that came down into the front courtyard on a night visit by uninvited guests are destroyed (crg_courtyard_gargoyles).
The animated armour guarding the east turret post is destroyed (crg_turret_guard).
The great chandelier over the castle's dining table was brought down in a fight (BattleScenery); it stays down.
